steps.npc: I hear you are the human that Veldaban has employed to help rebuild the statue. How is that going?

steps.player: How did you know about that?

steps.npc: Veldaban told me about your involvement in the rebuilding of the statue. Congratulations.
I am Bisi. I am the Supreme Commander of the Black Guard.

steps.player: I thought Veldaban was in command?

steps.npc: Only of our regiment in Keldagrim, and a most honourable position it is as well.
But the Black Guard has many regiments across the dwarven realm. All the Commanders of those regiments report to me.

steps.text: If Dwarf Cannon has been completed:

steps.player: Oh yes, I helped Commander Lawgof once, in his fight against the goblins.

steps.npc: Apart from the statue of King Alvis falling down, you mean? I don't know. There is something suspicious about the whole case.
We've had several incidents recently. For a while we even closed off the city. And now this.
The Red Axe has withdrawn from the city to some unknown location. I believe Commander Veldaban has asked you to assist him in finding their secret headquarters?
Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the [company name]?
There seems to be some general unrest in the city. There is trouble brewing in Keldagrim.
But I'm sure Commander Veldaban is on top of it. He's a very capable officer, and I'm starting to get too old for this sort of thing.

steps.text: After completing Between a Rock... and Forgettable Tale... (?):

steps.npc: Well, I heard that you helped Veldaban's father in the mines to the south. That's caused quite a bit of an upset in the Consortium, so I understand.
The amount of wealth that goldmine is generating might cause some distortion in the balance of power in the Consortium. But we'll see.
Apart from that there seems to be some general unrest in the city. Trouble is brewing in Keldagrim.
But I'm sure Commander Veldaban is on top of it. He's a very capable officer, and I'm starting to get too old for this sort of thing.
Then I bid you farewell, human.
